_comment: SHAPE REFERENCE — this is what a project's feature_list.json looks like once features are specified, planned, and built: the full schema-v2 kanban with sub-feature tasks, cross-feature dependencies, phases, evidence, and learning. A real project STARTS EMPTY — /install writes {"schema_version":2,"current_feature":null,"features":{}} to the project root, and grill (WHY/SPECIFY fields) then the lead (PLAN fields) fill it one feature at a time. Two example features below: 'order-totals' is done (passing); 'discount-codes' depends on it and is mid-build. WIP=1, links are reciprocal + acyclic, so validate-board.py accepts it.

order-totals.title: Order total calculation
order-totals.problem_statement: Carts show no running total, so shoppers cannot tell what they will pay before checkout.
order-totals.jtbd: When I add items to my cart, I want to see the order total update, so I can decide whether to keep shopping.
order-totals.user_context: Storefront shoppers on web; high traffic at checkout.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Total equals the sum of line subtotals, rounded once at the end
acceptance_criteria.verification: npm test -- total.spec.ts -t 'sums lines' 2>&1 | grep -q '1 passed'

tasks.title: Sum line subtotals with single final rounding

validation.business_metric: line-sum match verified on 1000 sampled carts

product: shoppers expect the total before, not at, checkout

discount-codes.title: Discount code application
discount-codes.problem_statement: Marketing cannot run promotions because the cart has no way to apply a discount code.
discount-codes.jtbd: When I have a promo code, I want to apply it at the cart, so I can get the advertised discount.
discount-codes.user_context: Shoppers with codes from email campaigns; codes are percentage or fixed-amount.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: A valid percentage code reduces the total by that percent of the pre-discount total
A valid fixed code reduces the total by the fixed amount, never below zero
An unknown or expired code is rejected and leaves the total unchanged

tasks.title: Apply percentage discount to the order total
Apply fixed-amount discount with a zero floor
